text: Powers Speciality Hospital has billed 56 claims in 1.3 years while reporting zero beds and one doctor; 94.6 percent of its inflow is arranged by a single broker, Sarah Newman, at the same registered address, and 100 percent of payouts route to one account. Its entire patient population consists of single-visit identities that never touch the rest of the graph. The name says hospital; the graph says shell — and it is the stack of independent strong features, not any one of them, that pushes this to high severity. The honest alternative, an aggressively marketed new specialty practice with an exclusive facilitator, fails to explain the complete absence of patient reuse or cross-clinic history. Next step: site verification and a hold on ACC_001599; if the premises exist and treat patients, the alert dies quickly.
